name: input
title: Input
description: A text field that plays its states: a pointer hovers and clicks it, it focuses with a ring, the value types in, then the field shows an invalid state.
useWhen: A sign-up or login demo needs a field focusing and filling in.
Showing validation: focus ring, typed value, error state.
avoidWhen: Only a blinking insertion point is needed: use caret.
A labelled form row with helper text: use field.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Placeholder
variables.description: Text shown while the field is empty.

variables.label: Value
variables.description: Text that types into the field.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
